props.description: A staircase of growth where someone tries to teleport from the bottom step to the top by reading a book — and phases right through, falling back to the start. Then they climb each step physically, each tread lighting up only when stepped on, never when merely pointed at. Knowledge illuminates the next step but cannot stand on it for you.
